events.verdict: Kennard (MEM) is firming up in Bridges' (NYK) path and marginal contact occurs as they come together during the pick.
Towns (NYK) initiates contact with Morant's (MEM) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Morant (MEM) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Towns (NYK) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Jackson Jr. (MEM) during the rebound.
Bridges (NYK) rests his right hand on Morant's (MEM) body and marginal contact occurs as he contests the driving shot attempt.
Morant (MEM) lunges toward the ball and marginal contact occurs with Bridges' (NYK) arm as Bridges secures the rebound.
Bane's (MEM) left hand makes clean contact with the ball on his dislodge attempt at the end of Brunson's (NYK) drive.
Edey (MEM) legally contests Bridges' (NYK) layup attempt.

Jackson Jr. (MEM) and Hart (NYK) both make clean contact with the loose ball in pursuit of the rebound and any contact as they come together is deemed incidental. Jackson Jr. stays inbounds as he saves the loose ball from going out of bounds.
Towns (NYK) extends his left hand toward the ball and marginal contact occurs with Morant's (MEM) arm, which does not affect Morant's ability to maintain full control of the ball.
Morant (MEM) extends his right arm out and lunges toward Bridges (NYK), causing the two players to engage in incidental foot to foot contact during Morant's dribble.
Morant (MEM) is not able to bring the ball across midcourt within 8 seconds. This is a violation.
Hart (NYK) establishes himself in Bane's (MEM) path and absorbs the marginal contact during the pick.
Bane (MEM) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Brunson (NYK) and Morant (MEM) briefly engage and immediately disengage as marginal contact occurs during the inbound.
Bridges (NYK) jumps into and initiates more-than-marginal contact with Morant's (MEM) shoulder and body, which alters his shot attempt near the rim.
Morant (MEM) moves alongside Brunson's (NYK) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Aldama (MEM) legally contests Anunoby's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Bridges (NYK) moves alongside Morant's (MEM) path and maintains a legal guarding position as incidental contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Robinson (NYK) jumps vertically and brings his arms into a vertical position. Any contact with Aldama (MEM) during the rebound is deemed incidental.
